environment: Managed-cloud disposable browser profiles; single runs while other checks could run concurrently.
scope: Only the recorded calendar-specific runs, not JSON/recovery round trips, manual-device tests or the complete release suite.

methodology.comparison: The scale-only 5,000+5,000 task dataset differs from the workspace round trip and the 251+251 functional suites; these are not direct speed comparisons.
methodology.timings: Scripted elapsed operation times include browser/driver work.
methodology.memory: Browser heap and process RSS were not measured.
methodology.limits: Real-device performance and system behavior remain unverified. Manual/batch modes retain full rendering.

scale_scope: 10,000 total tasks: 5,000 dated and 5,000 undated. Check initial 100-node limits and far-end search only, without walking every page or exporting/restoring the workspace.
functional_scope: Each engine used 251 dated and 251 undated tasks to exercise full pagination, real clicks, new-item focus, far-end search, resets, filtering and manual-order behavior.
